{
  "thinking": "Priya worries a curled fox becomes a blob. A sitting fox in profile with tall ears and a tail sweeping out keeps the outline readable and still matches the client's 'at rest' note. Time is short, so I'll offer that compromise and ask her to sketch it.",
  "say": "Fair point, Priya, a tight curl could turn to mush. What if the fox sits upright instead, side on, with two tall pointy ears, a pointed nose, and the big tail sweeping out along the ground so it's clearly separate from the body? That's calm and at rest, and it ties into the owner's favourite book. If you're already holding the pen, could you sketch that one? We've only got nine minutes, so if we all like it we can start fast. Leo, Maya, does that work for you?",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 6,
  "aligned": "fox",
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Client: bookshop window, calm/wise, no owls (Leo), no cat (Biscuit, Maya), owner's favourite book about a fox (Maya), friendly, at rest, sitting/curled, not hunting (mine). I'm aligned on fox. Maya and Leo are on fox; Priya is on elephant, worried a curled fox is a blob. I proposed an upright sitting fox in profile with tall ears and a tail sweeping out. Waiting on Priya. Then pad sketch, someone traces stroke 1 from start. If Priya won't budge and time runs short, consider conceding to elephant (also calm and wise)."
}
